nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) holding spending allowances.
Private uint256 total token supply, mutated by mint, burn and constructor.
Private string holding the ERC20 token name, set once in constructor.
Private string holding the ERC20 token symbol, set once in constructor.
Private address of the contract owner, used as the only access-control gate for mint.
Deploys token: sets name, symbol, mints totalSupply*10**10 to msg.sender and records _owner.
External view returning _name.
External view returning _symbol.
External view returning hard-coded decimals value 10.
External view returning _totalSupply.
External view returning _balances[account].
External transfer that subtracts from and adds to _balances without allowance or event checks.
External view returning the stored allowance of owner for spender.
External approval that overwrites _allowances[msg.sender][spender] with amount.
External delegated transfer: decrements allowance and balances, credits recipient, emits Transfer.
External function adding addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender.
External function subtracting subtractedValue from the caller's allowance, clamped to zero.
Owner-restricted mint that credits user balance and increases _totalSupply.
External burn that decrements the caller balance and _totalSupply with no authorization or event.
Caller-controlled address used for balance writes, allowances, owner check and minting.
_balances[msg.sender] -= amount in transfer; unchecked sender balance condition.
_allowances[sender][msg.sender] -= amount in transferFrom; allowance is decremented without any explicit check.
_allowances[msg.sender][spender] += addedValue; arithmetic allowance growth.
_allowances[msg.sender][spender] -= subtractedValue with manual zero-clamp branch.
require(msg.sender == _owner) access-control gate guarding mint.
_balances[msg.sender] -= amount in burn.
_totalSupply -= amount in burn.
totalSupply * (10 ** uint256(10)) arithmetic used for initial supply and initial balance.
_balances[user] += amount arithmetic inside mint.
_totalSupply += amount arithmetic inside mint.

edges.reason: name_ parameter is written into the _name state variable inside the constructor.
symbol_ parameter is written into the _symbol state variable inside the constructor.
totalSupply constructor parameter is multiplied by 10**10 to seed supply and balance.
totalSupply parameter feeds the scaling multiplication of the initial supply.
account parameter is used as the lookup key of _balances in balanceOf.
recipient parameter receives the amount in the balance addition of transfer.
amount parameter drives the balance subtraction/addition in transfer.
amount is the operand of the balance arithmetic performed by transfer.
owner parameter is the first index of the _allowances lookup in allowance.
spender parameter is the second index of the _allowances lookup in allowance.
amount parameter is stored as the approved allowance in approve.
spender parameter is the allowance key granted by approve.
sender parameter keys the allowance and balance debits in transferFrom.
recipient parameter receives the credited amount in transferFrom.
amount parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
amount is subtracted from the stored allowance by transferFrom.
spender parameter keys the allowance update in increaseAllowance.
addedValue parameter is added to the stored allowance.
addedValue is the addend of the allowance arithmetic in increaseAllowance.
spender parameter keys the allowance update in decreaseAllowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance.
subtractedValue is the subtrahend of the allowance arithmetic in decreaseAllowance.
user parameter is credited by the balance addition in mint.
amount parameter drives balance and supply additions in mint.
amount is added to _balances[user] by mint.
amount parameter drives balance and supply subtraction in burn.
amount is subtracted from the caller balance by burn.
